name: The Parts That Live
source:
Just a normal day in life with the people you love and cherish.

But one of them, is slowly going away...

[From [url=https://douglasagilestorm.itch.io/the-parts-that-live]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这本是与你深爱且珍视的人们共度的平凡一天。

然而他们之中的某个人，正一点点悄然远去……

[摘自[url=https://douglasagilestorm.itch.io/the-parts-that-live]itch.io[/url]]
